title: Replace Chat native file input with a styled accessible attachment control
description:
Problem: the Chat route still exposes a native `Choose File` input in the composer area. The browser audit reported the underlying `#chat-file-input` as an unlabeled interactive element, and visually it does not match the app's icon/button/tooltip affordance pattern.

Desired outcome: chat attachments use a MemorySmith-styled upload affordance with an accessible name, tooltip/help text, keyboard support, and clear selected-file feedback.

Scope:
- In scope: Chat composer attachment trigger, hidden file input labeling, selected attachment display, tooltip/aria description, and browser regression coverage.
- Out of scope: changing accepted file types, attachment payload processing, or chat model behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- The visible attachment control is styled consistently with the chat toolbar/composer controls.
- The hidden/native file input is not exposed as an unnamed interactive element.
- Keyboard and screen-reader users can discover and activate the attachment action.
- Selected attachments remain visible and removable before sending.

Validation:
- Browser audit of `/chat` reports no unlabeled file-input control.
- Route-smoke or focused Playwright coverage verifies the attachment button can receive focus and open the chooser path without breaking the composer.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 live browser audit: Chat's native file input is visible as `Choose File`, was flagged as unlabeled by the DOM sweep, and is inconsistent with the app's styled command controls.
